g.text: Status polling and retry messages support partial outages.
Keycloak login is implemented; no Stripe.
Only Product View accesses the MongoDB read model.
Synchronizer relays events through the owner's API.
Each SQL service owns its own isolated database.
GUID references cross service boundaries; no cross-database FKs.
Internal HTTP projection API + service token
Solid arrow: synchronous request / database access
service-common is a build library, not a running service.
